name: Link External Provider
summary: The authenticated user selects Microsoft as the representative provider permutation and explicitly links the validated, currently unlinked provider subject to the current durable identity.

preconditions.expression: the current durable user is authenticated and the selected provider subject is validated and not linked to any durable identity

serverInteraction.intent: Associate the validated provider subject only with the current durable identity; do not create or switch users and do not infer linking authority from provider email.

postconditions.expression: the selected provider subject is linked to the same authenticated durable identity

sourceReferences.note: Approved authentication policy requires independent NuvIoT email proof before an unlinked external provider may be linked to an existing durable identity; provider email is supporting evidence only.

External Identity Provider category reconciliation separates linked-subject sign-in, provider denial/fault, first-time registration, and provider link/unlink management while preserving provider-specific choices as permutations.
